reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 13 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 194 and 242 total points.

analyst.text: The Lakers open a four-game homestand on an eight-game win streak, and Austin Reaves (heel bruise) may play depending on 'pain tolerance', per JJ Redick. Charlotte look like a team in a funk since the LaMelo Ball trade, having lost 8 of 9, and Coby White asked 'how do we stop the bleeding?' with Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder hurt. The news angle leans towards the Lakers.
